verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows SigNoz giving visibility into its own observability spend or ingestion usage, attributing that spend to teams or services, or alerting on usage spikes before billing. The log-drop filter is a cost-reduction control, which is an adjacent feature, not spend visibility. The LLM cost tracing measures application token cost, which is a different capability.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can see what my observability spend is, attribute it to teams or services, and catch usage spikes before the bill
